The environment variable is `OLLAMA_MODELS`. You set it in your user account, and it points to the directory where you want models stored. "set the environment variable `OLLAMA_MODELS` in your user account." [ollama/docs/windows.md]

The steps are: open Settings (Windows 11) or Control Panel (Windows 10), search for _environment variables_, click _Edit environment variables for your account_, create or edit `OLLAMA_MODELS` with the target directory, then click OK/Apply. "Edit or create a new variable for your user account for `OLLAMA_MODELS` where you want the models stored" [ollama/docs/windows.md]

If Ollama is already running, quit the tray application and relaunch it from the Start menu, or open a new terminal after saving the variables. "If Ollama is already running, Quit the tray application and relaunch it from the Start menu, or a new terminal started after you saved the environment variables." [ollama/docs/windows.md]
